p: PTN Global was founded by Tam Phan who is based in Melbourne, Australia. Tam has worked in the IT industry for almost 30 years and was the Managing Director of TMA Solutions Australia between 2011 and 2019. Prior to TMA Solutions, Tam was the Business Lead of the Telstra Self Service Channel Transformation Program where he then went on to become the Co-Founder and CTO of eXceed Global.

p: Tam has always been passionate about providing solutions in the IT industry. His experience has helped him identify opportunities to solve the shortage of qualified IT personnel and stringent time to market by crafting a hybrid model that seeks better results and outputs with lesser business risk and costs for his clients.

h2: How we follow to complete your project

p: From vision to reality. We comprehend clients' stories and pain points, validate ideas, and define the project scope and key objectives. Through interactive workshops, stakeholder interviews, and brainstorming sessions, we set the stage for in-depth discussion and solution design.

p: From concept to strategy. We map out a detailed project plan, covering project timelines, budget estimates, and resource allocation. Our experts propose tech stacks, methods, and tools suited for your case, define processes, and structure teams.

p: From concept to prototype. We translate your ideas into intuitive and visually engaging designs that prioritize user experience. Our UI/UX team conducts research for user personas, creates detailed wireframes and interactive prototypes.

p: From vision to blueprint. We lay the foundation for your custom software by defining its technical structure, design principles, and technology stack. The architecture acts as a blueprint, ensuring scalability, performance, and security, while facilitating the harmonious integration of a robust backend with an intuitive, user-centric frontend.

p: From code to quality. Our professionals bring your idea to life, from prototyping to a full build. We strictly adhere to coding standards, follow quality assurance measures, and apply rigorous testing processes to ensure rolling out a success. We ensure frequent feedback loops for transparency.

p: From staging to live. We work to ensure a smooth final release, whether it is a phased rollout or a full launch. Our team assists with deployment, configuration, and staff training for minimal disruption and easy handover.

p: From launch to enhancement. Our team remains within reach after the project sign-off. We provide ongoing support, continuous updates, and enhancements as needed to ensure your solution stays robust and relevant, based on our SLA contracts.

p: About custom software development with PTN.
summary: What is Custom Software Development?

p: Custom software development is the process of designing, building, and deploying software tailored to your organization’s specific needs. Unlike off-the-shelf products, custom solutions align directly with your workflows, goals, and growth strategy, ensuring greater efficiency, scalability, and competitive advantage.
summary: How do you protect sensitive data and ensure security in custom software?

p: We prioritize security at every stage by implementing data encryption, secure authentication protocols, and role-based access control. Our team follows OWASP best practices and conducts regular code reviews and penetration testing to safeguard your data against evolving cyber threats.
summary: Can you integrate custom software with my existing tools and systems?

p: Yes. Our custom solutions are built with API-first design and modular architecture, enabling seamless integration with your existing systems-whether ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, or third-party applications. This ensures smooth workflows and improved productivity.
summary: Do you provide post-launch support and maintenance for custom software?

p: Absolutely. We offer comprehensive post-launch support, including performance monitoring, regular updates, bug fixes, and feature enhancements. Our goal is to ensure your software continues to evolve with your business and remains reliable long-term.
summary: What is your process for managing development and ensuring timely delivery?

p: We follow an Agile development methodology, breaking projects into manageable sprints for transparency and flexibility. This approach ensures: - Clear milestones and progress tracking - Continuous testing and feedback loops - On-time delivery without compromising quality
